_README: Canonical deterministic conformance corpus. Inputs are hand-authored; expected outputs are generated from the authoritative native Dart core (oracle/gen_oracle_test.dart) and verified against the compiled-JS core. Timestamps use the sentinel {"__ts__": <epoch_ms>} so both adapters convert identically; a raw string/number in a timestamp slot is a deliberate malformed-input case and is passed through untouched.

go.name: G01 empty pool -> noToilets
G02 single OSM primary, no evidence -> nearestWithNoStrongEvidence
G03 two OSM primaries; nearer has NO evidence, farther has corr-usable WITHIN detour -> promote (recentCorroboratedUsableWithinDetour)
G04 corr-usable farther REJECTED by absolute 400m cap (delta 500m) -> nearestWithNoStrongEvidence
G05 corr-usable farther REJECTED by 1.5x ratio (300 -> 500 is within 400 abs but 500 > 450) -> nearest
G06 nearest primary corroborated-UNAVAILABLE, an escape within BOTH detour guards (200 -> 250) -> avoidedRecentCorroboratedUnavailable
G07 nearest primary corr-UNAVAILABLE, NO escape in detour -> bestMappedOptionCorroboratedUnavailable (requiresConfirmation)
G08 nearest primary carries a SINGLE unavailable report -> singleNegativeWarning (still selected, cautioned)
G09 nearest primary CONFLICTED unavailable majority -> conflictedNegativeWarning
G10 no primary; one uncorroborated community submission -> communitySubmissionFallback (requiresConfirmation)
G11 community submission WITH corroborated-usable -> primary (communityCorroborated) recentCorroboratedUsableWithinDetour
G12 only candidate (needs_confirm) toilets -> candidateFallback (requiresConfirmation, evidence cannot promote)
G13 only unknown-identity toilets -> candidateFallback reason with unknownIdentity caution
G14 every option moderation-flagged -> onlyFlaggedOrUnconfirmedOptions (no selection)
G15 flagged one EXCLUDED, an unflagged primary selected + flagged never appears as an alternative
G16 three primaries -> selected + 2 alternatives from same tier, distance sorted
G17 invalid distances (NaN / negative / Infinity) dropped; the one valid primary wins
G18 EXPIRED corr-usable does NOT promote (evidence ignored) -> nearest chosen, no promotion
G19 order-independence: same pool as G16 shuffled -> identical result
G20 ratings + votes present but NO condition -> zero GO authority, plain nearest
G21 farther corr-usable ACCEPTED (near 300, far 400: delta 100<=400 and 400<=450) -> recentCorroboratedUsableWithinDetour promotes 'far'
G22 nearest primary corroborated-usable BUT water reported out + lock reported out -> positive selection carrying water/lock cautions
BND-G1 gap == 400.0 exactly -> PROMOTE (withinEvidenceDetour is <=400)
BND-G2 gap == 400.001 -> do NOT promote -> nearest
BND-G3 ratio == 1.5 exactly (300 -> 450) -> PROMOTE
BND-G4 ratio == 1.5 + eps (300 -> 450.001) -> do NOT promote
BND-G5 equal distance -> deterministic lexical id order (bbb vs aaa -> aaa)
BND-G6 near-equal distance (200.0 vs 200.0000001) -> nearer id wins
